column1: % contribution of Broader Categories towards CPI:
1. Essential daily categories maintain steady impact
Categories such as fashion, fuel & light, food & beverages, and education contribute around 8.2%–8.5%, reflecting stable and consistent spending patterns on everyday essentials.
Pan, tobacco, and intoxicants account for the highest share of overall CPI at 9.3%, indicating a strong impact of these items on inflation and price movements.
3. Health and personal care are significant drivers
Health and personal care each contribute 8.6% to CPI, showing that medical and hygiene-related expenses play a major role in household spending.
4. Transport and recreation have comparatively lower influence
Transport & communication (7.6%) and recreation & amusement (7.9%) contribute the least to CPI, suggesting relatively lower consumer spending or smaller price fluctuations in these categories.
